Riverholt Housing Association
Riverside House, 2 Example Wharf
Woolwich SE18 0XX
Asset Management · Tel 020 7946 0127 · assets@riverholt-ha.example
For the attention of Paul Denning, Branch Manager
Demo Decorating Contractors Ltd (Erith branch)
Unit 4, Example Trade Park
Erith DA8 2XX
3 August 2026
Letter of acceptance
Contract: External redecoration programme 2026 - Marsh View Estate (your job J-4102)
Our contract reference: RHA/AM/2026/014
Following the tender returned on 14 July 2026, Riverholt Housing Association accepts your tender for the external
redecoration of Heron Court, Plover Court and Avocet Court, Marsh View Estate, in the sum of £148,600.00
excluding VAT.
The works will be carried out under the terms of the measured term contract dated 1 April 2025. Start on site: 17
August 2026. Completion: 18 December 2026. Retention: 3%, half released at completion.
Monthly valuations are to be submitted to the contract administrator, Graham Lister, by the last working day of
each month. Payment is due 30 days from the date of a valid invoice.
Please sign and return the attached copy to confirm acceptance.
Yours faithfully,
Andrea Wills
Head of Asset Management, Riverholt Housing Association
